failure_condition: RETAIL_REC mean over the next 28 days is not higher than the prior 28-day mean despite WORKPLACES continuing to rise, or WORKPLACES stalls/reverses while RETAIL_REC still rises.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 6.3 to 4.0 over four weeks, signaling reduced home-confinement behavior. evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 6.3 to 4.0 across the snapshot weeks
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL crosses below 4.0 but RETAIL_REC mean over the next two weeks does not increase relative to the prior two weeks, or RESIDENTIAL stays above 4.0 while RETAIL_REC still rises.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in TRANSIT (-44.1 to -37.7) and WORKPLACES (-16.3 to -11.4) jointly indicates restored commuting activity; their combined recovery amplifies retail visits beyond what either series alone predicts, driving a stronger four-week rise in RETAIL_REC than a simple additive model would suggest.
evidence_refs: fact:both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improved in every successive week of the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks is no greater than what is predicted by TRANSIT or WORKPLACES individually, indicating no interaction effect, or one series reverses while the other keeps improving without any joint acceleration in RETAIL_REC.
